gpu_layers.description: Number of model layers to offload to GPU (llama.cpp --n-gpu-layers). 0 keeps the model on CPU (the DLC CPU image default); -1 offloads every layer (full GPU). Use this to split a model across CPU and GPU when it does not fit entirely in GPU memory.

threads.description: CPU threads used for generation (llama.cpp --threads). The dominant latency lever on CPU instances (0 lets llama.cpp pick).

flash_attn.description: Enable llama.cpp's Flash Attention kernel (--flash-attn). A build-level toggle exposed as an env flag.
